content.title: NEOG Q3 Deep Dive: Q3 Results, Guidance Reaffirmed, and Operational Turnaround in Focus
content.summary: Life sciences company Neogen (NASDAQ:NEOG) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 3.6% year on year to $209.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $830 million at the midpoint came in 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.04 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
